system.description: Starting at 14th level, your Crash, Overheat state flares up to white hot levels. When you would enter Overheat, by spending 2 Focus as part of entering the enhanced state, you enter Burnout. While in Burnout you gain the benefits of Overheat, you gain 1 Pyroclasm at the end of each of your turns and you may use the Detonate ability as a bonus action, while also treating it as if it were a Ninjutsu with the Release being cast. But while in Burnout, you take 3d6 fire damage at the end of each of your turns. This damage cannot be reduced, resisted or ignored by any means.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
